_comment: Operator brand routing (the C3 brand map; docs/systems/brands.md). Each rule maps a cwd/transcript-path/workspace-slug keyword (a case-insensitive regex) to a brand label; memories + the SessionStart banner are scoped by the inferred brand. First match wins; no match => no brand (the memory layer fails closed to brand-neutral). Path separators (backslash, slash, space) all match one another, so "Projects/ClientA" matches G:\My Drive\Projects\ClientA and the Claude Code slug g--My-Drive-Projects-ClientA. The default 'ai-ecosystem' rule covers THIS stack's own workspace. ADD YOUR OWN rules for your projects, e.g. {"pattern": "Projects/ClientA", "brand": "brand-a"}. OPTIONAL keys: "shared_brands": labels every scope may see (the admission gate treats them as neutral; also settable with MEM0_SHARED_BRANDS in stack.env). "content_rule_workspaces" + "content_rules": for a workspace that mixes brands, classify each FACT by its own text - exactly one distinct brand matched => that brand, none or several => no brand, e.g. "content_rule_workspaces": ["Projects/Mixed"], "content_rules": [{"pattern": "alpha-store", "brand": "brand-a"}, {"pattern": "beta-shop", "brand": "brand-b"}]. A file without the optional keys behaves exactly as before. OPTIONAL: add a "campaign" field to a rule to sub-scope a brand into isolated funnels/sub-projects, e.g. {"pattern": "myfunnel", "brand": "myapp", "campaign": "myfunnel"} - a session then surfaces the brand's shared (campaign-less) canonical facts PLUS only its own campaign's rules, never another campaign's. Put campaign sub-rules BEFORE the broad brand rule (first match wins). This file is deployed to ~/.claude/scripts/brands.json on first install and NOT overwritten on re-install, so your customizations persist.
